schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of the build and test tools merge on their own after the CI jobs pass
Minor and patch updates of the GitHub Actions merge on their own after the CI jobs pass
Patch updates of the packages that ship in the app merge on their own after the CI jobs pass
Each major update of the packages that can break the app gets its own pull request and a label
TypeScript stays below 6.1. The linter (typescript-eslint) needs the JavaScript API of TypeScript, which version 7 does not have. Remove this rule when typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
Electron and the packager never merge on their own, because a test in the real app is needed. This rule comes last, so it wins over the rules above.
